issue.title: User initialization task support
issue.body:
Resolves: #32123 
Resolves: #34643

The pull request introduces an annotation `@PreStart` that is meant to annotate `Runnable` classes to mark that they should run during the initialization phase of the application (before Startup).

Updates:
- Flyway, Liquibase and Liquibase Mongo adopted `@Initialization`
- Each initialization task is masked to a different Kubernetes Job.
- Add support of task filtering.
- Allow non-Runnalbe tasks (the runnable is generated).
- Rename `@Initialization` to `@PreStart`.
- Added integration test that ensure that user provided task are executed

> @iocanel are you handling this or should I take a look?

I am trying to verify my findings just to make sure I am not doing something wrong. Will let you know.

I rebuilt main and tried it with a few differnet examples. The issue is definitely there.
My understanding is that the `PreventFurtherStepsException` never reaches the `ApplicationLifeCycle` manager as is the expected and therefore it seems to end up waiting here: https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/blob/main/core/runtime/src/main/java/io/quarkus/runtime/ApplicationLifecycleManager.java#L152

The exception seems to be caught by the generated `ApplicationImpl` and trigger a `close` in the `StartupContext`. Not sure if this is how it should be working. Here I will definitely need some help @geoand.

I see that the AppCDs generation feature which depends on `PreventFurtherStepsException` works as expected.

Now let me try and see what is going on in your case.
